svg.title: The Callout Studio editor
svg.desc: The Callout Studio New callout window designing an Idea callout: display name, IDs idea and spark, the Purple color, the Lucide lightbulb icon, and live previews of the heading, inline and block formats beside the icon adjustment sliders.
